Periodus I.
Canon 1.
main_text.p: Chalifatum Fessæ condidit condi tu ab Idri.Idris.

main_text.p: Hi Saraceni occuparunt Cretam, Siciliam, Sardiniam, Corsicam, Maltam & Italiæ partem.

page.notes: The first word of the running head is partly illegible in the scan at the top, read as "Regnum". The note "condi tu ab Idri." is rendered as printed with a superscript and abbreviation; the reading "condi tu" is uncertain. The word "Fesur" in the explicatio is uncertain and is likely the printer's "Fesur" for Fessæ; the scan reads "Fezur"/"Fesur" faintly. The ligature in "Hic Jdris" is copied as printed. The line "Ita, ut omnes penè Maris Mediterranei" lines are reproduced with the printed hyphen at "Medi-terranei". The last line "E rum" is a catchword-like line of the printed sheet and is retained as text, with the separation as printed.
